productOnPage.description: Yoto Says: Get ready to move, groove, and light up the room with high-energy dance beats for kids! Whether it's a kitchen disco or a full living room takeover, this album is built for pure, joyful movement from the very first beat. "Disco Feet" and "Dancing in the Stars" are instant crowd-pleasers, and "After School Boogie" is the perfect antidote to a long school day. Every track comes loaded with the kind of hook that gets into your feet before your brain even notices.These songs were designed for little ears and little feet but with the same tools, talent and level of detail that goes into crafting any major dance hit. The team used studios, session players and singers from around the UK to create the perfect sonic mix. productOnPage.descriptionHtml:
Whether it's a kitchen disco or a full living room takeover, this album is built for pure, joyful movement from the very first beat. "Disco Feet" and "Dancing in the Stars" are instant crowd-pleasers, and "After School Boogie" is the perfect antidote to a long school day. Every track comes loaded with the kind of hook that gets into your feet before your brain even notices.


These songs were designed for little ears and little feet but with the same tools, talent and level of detail that goes into crafting any major dance hit. The team used studios, session players and singers from around the UK to create the perfect sonic mix. No experience required, just turn it up and dance.


All Tracks Written by Daniel Wilkin/Ben Cullum/Joey Swarbrick

All Tracks Produced by Ben Cullum/Daniel Wilkin

All Vocals By Danielle Mahailet, Daniel Wilkin and Ben Cullum

Mixed and Mastered Ben Cullum/Daniel Wilkin
productOnPage.descriptionMarkdown:
**_Yoto Says: Get ready to move, groove, and light up the room with high-energy dance beats for kids!._**

Whether it's a kitchen disco or a full living room takeover, this album is built for pure, joyful movement from the very first beat. "Disco Feet" and "Dancing in the Stars" are instant crowd-pleasers, and "After School Boogie" is the perfect antidote to a long school day. Every track comes loaded with the kind of hook that gets into your feet before your brain even notices.  
  
  
  
  
These songs were designed for little ears and little feet but with the same tools, talent and level of detail that goes into crafting any major dance hit. The team used studios, session players and singers from around the UK to create the perfect sonic mix. No experience required, just turn it up and dance.  
  
  
  
  
All Tracks Written by Daniel Wilkin/Ben Cullum/Joey Swarbrick  
  
All Tracks Produced by Ben Cullum/Daniel Wilkin  
  
All Vocals By Danielle Mahailet, Daniel Wilkin and Ben Cullum  
  
Mixed and Mastered Ben Cullum/Daniel Wilkin

Tracks included:

*   1 Step, 2 Step
*   After School Boogie
*   Can U Keep Up?
*   Dancing In The Stars
*   Disco Feet
*   Do Your Thing
*   If You Wanna Dance
*   Let Loose!
*   We Own The Dance Floor
*   Wiggle Wiggle

Creators are independent audio makers bringing their original stories, games, songs and more to Yoto Cards. We hand-pick the best and freshest ideas — so every Creators Card meets the Yoto gold standard.

[Explore the Creators Collection](/creators/)

[Read Creator biographies](https://yoto.space/creator-profiles)
